tooltip.relicweave.gate_keystone: Place at the centre of a 3x3 ring of Concordance Frames, then use a Threshold Sigil on it.
message.relicweave.gate.incomplete: The gate is incomplete: surround the keystone with eight Concordance Frames.
message.relicweave.gate.locked: The gate does not answer. Free the End first.
message.relicweave.gate.inactive: The gate is dormant. Use a Threshold Sigil on the keystone.
message.relicweave.gate.busy: A ritual is already under way.
message.relicweave.gate.unavailable: The way is closed. The Vestige cannot be reached.
message.relicweave.gate.waystone_dormant: The waystone is silent here. It only answers inside The Vestige.
